observations.text: 用python做一个躲避球游戏，泰裤辣！（附源码）注意：运行需要安装pygame的软件包
segments: 用python做一个躲避球游戏，泰裤辣！（附源码）注意：运行需要安装pygame的软件包

observations.text: import pygame import random import time pygame.init() # 游戏窗口 window_width = 800 window_height = 600 # 颜色 black = (0, 0, 0) white = (255, 255, 255) # 创建 window = pygame.display.set_mode((window_width, window_height)) pygame.display.set_caption("躲躲躲1.0") # 游戏时钟 clock = pygame.time.Clock() # 玩家 player_radius = 20 player_x = window_width // 2 player_y = window_height - player_radius player_speed = 10 # 障碍物 obstacle_width = 100 obstacle_height = 20 obstacle_x = random.randint(0, window_width - obstacle_width) obstacle_y = 0 obstacle_speed = 3 # 游戏难度 difficulty = 1 # 游戏结束 game_over = False # 存活时间 start_time = time.time() # 游戏循环 while not game_over: for event in pygame.event.get(): if event.type == pygame.QUIT: game_over = True # 键盘输入 keys = pygame.key.get_pressed() if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]: player_x -= player_speed if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]: player_x += player_speed # 更新玩家 if player_x < 0: player_x = 0 elif player_x > window_width - player_radius: player_x = window_width - player_radius # 更新障碍物 obstacle_y += obstacle_speed * difficulty # 检测碰撞 if obstacle_y > window_height: obstacle_x = random.randint(0, window_width - obstacle_width) obstacle_y = 0 difficulty += 0.1 if (obstacle_y <= player_y + player_radius <= obstacle_y + obstacle_height) and ( obstacle_x <= player_x <= obstacle_x + obstacle_width): game_over = True # 绘制游戏场景 window.fill(black) pygame.draw.circle(window, white, (player_x, player_y), player_radius) pygame.draw.rect(window, white, (obstacle_x, obstacle_y, obstacle_width, obstacle_height)) pygame.display.update() # 控制游戏帧率 clock.tick(60) # 计算存活时间 end_time = time.time() survival_time = int(end_time - start_time) # 输出存活时间 print("存活时间：", survival_time, "秒") # 游戏结束，退出Pygame pygame.quit()

In this tutorial series we will be working to create the famous snake game in python with the module pygame. If you are more interested in a general pygame tutorial series click here
Starter Code
To make our lives a bit easier I've set up the main structure for our game already. We are going to be using two main classes (snake and cube).
Creating our Game Loop
In all games we have a loop called a "main loop" or "game loop". This loop will continuously run until the game is exited. It is mainly responsible for checking for events and calling functions and methods based on those events.
We are going to be coding our game loop inside the main() function. We will declare some variables at the top of the function then move into our while loop which will represent our game loop.
```python
def main(): 
    global width, rows, s
    width = 500  # Width of our screen
    height = 500  # Height of our screen
    rows = 20  # Amount of rows

    win = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))  # Creates our screen object

    s = snake((255,0,0), (10,10))  # Creates a snake object which we will code later

    clock = pygame.time.Clock() # creating a clock object

    flag = True
    # STARTING MAIN LOOP
    while flag:
        pygame.time.delay(50)  # This will delay the game so it doesn't run too quickly
        clock.tick(10)  # Will ensure our game runs at 10 FPS
        redrawWindow(win)  # This will refresh our screen
```
Updating the Screen
It is usually good practice to do all of our drawing of objects from within one function or method. We will be using the redrawWindow function to update the display. We call this function once a frame from our game loop.
We will be adding more to this function later. However, for now we will simply draw the grid lines.
